en: This is a vintage postcard featuring a sepia-toned illustration. The upper left shows grapevines with grape clusters, which continue as decorative elements around the card. In the upper right, there is a circular portrait of a smiling girl holding a wine glass. The lower half features an illustration of a large Gothic building complex (likely a cathedral or castle) with tall spires. The phrase 'Gruss aus Meissen.' is printed in red, and there is a vertical text '1463 Brück & Sohn, Meissen.' on the right edge. The signature 'M. Näther' appears near the lower right.
